## Napoleon rendering

* The Google-style `Args:` become a field list (`param …` / `type …`): 36 of the 38 parameters of `determine_periods` get a field; without one: ['prominence', 'prominence_relative'] (the `Args:` section of the docstring does not document them).
* The fields are NOT grouped into Sphinx's "Parameters" block: the docstring opens with an rst section title ("Defaults (item 31, then C1 …)" with an underline), so everything after it, the field list included, sits inside a `<section>` and is no longer a direct child of the function's content, which is all Sphinx's doc-field transform reads. HTML tags between the function and its field list: ['section'].
* Fixing it is a docstring edit in `cyclophaser/` (for example the title turned into a paragraph or a napoleon `Note:` section) and was not done here.
